statement: Over a field k of characteristic zero, the quadratically enriched count of rational plane cubics through a general point configuration with prescribed finite separable residue fields σ=(L1,…,Lr), of total degree eight, is 2h+Σ_i Tr_(Li/k)⟨1⟩ in GW(k). For eight k-rational points this is 2h+8⟨1⟩, of rank12 and real signature8.

answer.text: 2h+Σ_i Tr_(Li/k)⟨1⟩ in GW(k); 2h+8⟨1⟩ for eight k-rational points

source.location: Section 8.2 and Table 1, printed pages 56–57; characteristic-zero setup in Section 1.2.1
source.version: arXiv:2307.01936v2 (28 February 2026), primary PDF inspected 4 November 2026

scope: Quadratically enriched count of irreducible rational plane cubics with eight geometric point conditions grouped into prescribed finite separable residue fields of total degree eight, over characteristic-zero k.
notes:
The original enriched cubic formula is computed in Kass–Levine–Solomon–Wickelgren §8.2/Table 1. Here h=⟨1⟩+⟨−1⟩ and Tr_(σ/k) is the sum of the residue-field trace forms. The later tropical paper arXiv:2502.02569v4 establishes the correspondence and reproduces the multiquadratic specializations. This updates the source attribution and extends the previously recorded k-rational specialization; it is not a second duplicate result. The characteristic-zero restriction is sufficient for the cited setup.

The later tropical restatement is retained only as verification; the cubic formula is associated with the original Kass–Levine–Solomon–Wickelgren computation.
